page.overview:
Who is Queen of Spades?

The Queen of Spades is a character in the fictional Grimm Fairy Tales universe, who first appeared in 2010 in Tales from Wonderland: The White Knight. The character was created by Raven Gregory, Troy Brownfield, Ralph Tedesco, and Joe Brusha.

Alone in the Realm of Dreams, the Jabberwocky desired companionship. He took down a sky whale, and ate the sacred, ancient entity. Its death shook the foundations of the realm, resulting in the birth of a new entity, the Queen of Spades which emerged from the Jabberwocky's shadow. An entity who controlled the shadows and desires to conquer all of Wonderland, the Queen of Spades has displayed both good and evil tendencies.

Category:Magic Users Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works
